title: WPMS/643/2013 of KM NUPUR DHAUNDHIYAL Vs VICE CHANCELLOR H.N.B.GARHWAL UNIVERSITY and ORS

paras.text:
WPMS No.643 of 2013
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.

Mr. V.B.S. Negi, Senior Advocate assisted
by Mr. Sanjay Raturi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. Paresh Tripathi, Advocate for the
respondent nos.1 to 4.
 Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for respondent
no.6.
 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
 This petition has been filed by the
petitioner for quashing the order dated
22.02.2013 passed by respondent no.4 by which
the entire result of the examination of B.Sc. IInd
year of the petitioner was cancelled. Further
prayer has been made for direction to the
respondents to declare the result of the petitioner
for B.Sc. IInd year examination.
 This case was heard on 02.04.2013 on
which date University counsel was directed to
produce the record pertaining to papers in
question on next date. The matter was heard on
08.04.2013. The Court after hearing the learned
counsel for the parties, passed the following
order:-
 "I have perused the two answer sheets of
the petitioner. One attempted by the
petitioner before unauthorized material
was found on her table, and another,
which the petitioner attempted thereafter. I
find that the petitioner has attempted most
of the questions in second answer sheet
also. Some answers were correctly
attempted by her in both the answer
sheets. Considering this fact, and in the
interest of justice, an interim mandamus is
issued to the respondents to permit the
petitioner to appear in the B.Sc. IIIrd
 year
examination provisionally. Such
permission shall be subject to the final
decision of the writ petition."

Today the matter is again heard. Senior
Advocate for the petitioner referred the
instruction regarding unfair means. It is admitted
to all the parties that action in unfair means
matter is taken as per this instructions. The
second instruction provides that where possibility
of use of unfair means is there but that
unauthorized material is not used, in that event,
the valuation of first answer sheet would be
cancelled and the result would be declared after
giving strong warning and by awarding marks on
answer sheets. In the present case, I have
personally seen the original record. The report of
Assistant Superintendent is also signed by
Central Superintendent, Board of College:
 "(a) Whether at the time of flying squad
 candidate was using unauthorized
 material. Answer was given-No.
 (b) Whether unfair material was
placed at a place from where the same
 would have been used easily-Yes.
 (c) Whether candidate misbehaved-
 No."
 Considering the above report of the
Assistant Superintendent Examination/Central
Superintendent, it is clear that petitioner was not
using unfair means. Therefore, the case of the
petitioner is covered under para 3 of the
instructions. Whereas in the present case, the
action has been taken by the University under
para 3 of the instruction. Considering the above, I
allow the writ petition. Set aside the order dated
22.02.2013 passed by respondent no.4 and direct
the Director, University to pass appropriate order
as per para 2 of the instructions within a period
of two weeks from the date of production of
certified copy of the order.

Original record is return to the University
Counsel. Since petitioner was not at fault, the
University is directed to conduct written
examination of the college concerned. After final
decision is taken and practical examination of the
petitioner is conducted, the University is directed
to declare the result of the petitioner.
 Modification application no.3503 of 2013
as well as Misc. application no.2175 of 2013
stand disposed of.
